# Thunderbird (102 and later) adding a CalDAV account by server address:
# discovery from the server root, a getctag poll, an ETag listing at depth 1
# and a multiget, then a sync-collection once the token is offered.
# Written from published client behaviour (Thunderbird's calendar provider
# documentation and RFC 4791/6578), not captured traffic. Thunderbird writes
# DAV: as D:, CalDAV as C: and CS as CS:.

### the server root
PROPFIND /dav/
Depth: 0
Content-Type: application/xml; charset=utf-8

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:prop><D:resourcetype/><D:owner/><D:current-user-principal/><D:supported-report-set/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP /dav/ {DAV:}current-user-principal 200 {principal}
PROP /dav/ {DAV:}owner 404

### capabilities of the home
OPTIONS {home}

EXPECT 200
HEADER DAV 1, 3, access-control, calendar-access

### the principal
PROPFIND {principal}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><C:calendar-home-set/><C:calendar-user-address-set/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {principal} {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-home-set 200 {home}

### the calendars in the home
PROPFIND {home}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/" xmlns:A="http://apple.com/ns/ical/"><D:prop><D:resourcetype/><D:displayname/><D:current-user-privilege-set/><A:calendar-color/><C:supported-calendar-component-set/><CS:getctag/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 4
PROP {web} {DAV:}displayname 200 Web
PROP {web} {http://apple.com/ns/ical/}calendar-color 404
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}current-user-privilege-set 200 <d:read/>

### the collection's tag and sync support
PROPFIND {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:CS="http://calendarserver.org/ns/"><D:prop><CS:getctag/><D:sync-token/><D:supported-report-set/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
PROP {assigned} {DAV:}supported-report-set 200 <c:calendar-multiget/>
SAVE ctag {assigned} {http://calendarserver.org/ns/}getctag

### the ETags at depth 1
PROPFIND {assigned}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:propfind xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:prop><D:getcontenttype/><D:resourcetype/><D:getetag/></D:prop></D:propfind>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 4
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getetag 200 "
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {DAV:}getcontenttype 200 text/calendar

### the objects
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 1

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<C:calendar-multiget xmlns:D="DAV:" xmlns:C="urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav"><D:prop><D:getetag/><C:calendar-data/></D:prop><D:href>{assigned}{open1}.ics</D:href><D:href>{assigned}{open2}.ics</D:href><D:href>{assigned}{done}.ics</D:href></C:calendar-multiget>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 3
PROP {assigned}{open1}.ics {urn:ietf:params:xml:ns:caldav}calendar-data 200 BEGIN:VTODO

### a sync from the advertised token, nothing changed
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:sync-collection xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:sync-token>{ctag}</D:sync-token><D:sync-level>1</D:sync-level><D:prop><D:getcontenttype/><D:getetag/></D:prop></D:sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 0
SAVE token sync-token
SAME ctag token

### the task is cancelled in the browser
DO cancel open1

### the incremental sync reports it gone
REPORT {assigned}
Depth: 0

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<D:sync-collection xmlns:D="DAV:"><D:sync-token>{token}</D:sync-token><D:sync-level>1</D:sync-level><D:prop><D:getcontenttype/><D:getetag/></D:prop></D:sync-collection>
EXPECT 207
RESPONSES 1
STATUS {assigned}{open1}.ics 404

### a GET of the departed object
GET {assigned}{open1}.ics

EXPECT 404
